summary: The discussion centers on a proposal to enable on‑demand lookups of a static side during joins, aiming to reduce latency for real‑time and streaming workloads. The discussion addresses an issue where Istio’s STRICT mTLS mode rejects traffic to pod IPs not backed by a Service, causing executor-to-executor communication failures in Spark. The discussion proposes a unified API and execution protocol for user-defined functions that can run in any language via external workers, enabling Spark Connect to support UDFs in Go, Rust, Swift, .NET, and more. Vote in progress: 0 binding +1 The discussion proposes an optional fallback resolver that will be consulted when an application references a V2 catalog name that has not been pre‑configured in Spark.
